resources.string: NexVital connects with Google Health Connect to securely read steps, heart rate metrics, sleep duration, and active energy expenditure from your Wear OS devices, Pixel Watch, and Fitbit.\n\nThis data is utilized strictly for real-time preventive coaching, circadian sleep optimization, and medication adherence reminders. NexVital complies with Google Play Health Connect policy: your health data is never sold, transferred to third-party brokers, or used for advertising.
